title: INCIDENT #IND-2026-001
region: Arabian Sea — off the Gujarat coast, India (demo AOI)

source_reconstruction.note: Observed spill location may differ from release location because of ocean and wind-driven drift.

sar_ais_check.note: Potential AIS-dark / inconsistent vessel detected near the spill scene. This does not establish responsibility; it is flagged for manual investigation.

ais_search.search_region: Probable source region + estimated release-time window

replay_events.label: Vessel enters source region
replay_events.detail: MV Ocean Crest enters the probable source region on a routine transit heading.

replay_events.label: Release window opens
replay_events.detail: Backward hindcast places the start of the plausible release window here.

replay_events.label: Speed anomaly begins
replay_events.detail: MV Ocean Crest slows from ~12.5 kt to ~3 kt — consistent with a discharge event.

replay_events.label: Probable release (mid-window)
replay_events.detail: Midpoint of the estimated release-time window used for the drift model.

replay_events.label: Speed resumes
replay_events.detail: MV Ocean Crest returns to transit speed and continues on course.

replay_events.label: Release window closes
replay_events.detail: End of the estimated release-time window from the hindcast ensemble.

replay_events.label: Slick drifting
replay_events.detail: Wind and current begin advecting the slick south-west, away from the source.

replay_events.label: Satellite observes slick
replay_events.detail: Sentinel-1 SAR acquisition captures the slick at its observed location, ~9 km from the source.

disclaimer: Attribution score is an investigation aid, not a legal determination of responsibility.
